question: 请依据 Microsoft FY2025 10-K，提供 Microsoft Cloud、Intelligent Cloud 与 Azure 的口径定义及 FY2025 对应披露指标，明确金额/增长率差异，不推算未披露Azure收入。
reviewer: Codex e1_gold_reading; frozen-standard original-source review; prior history and attempt01 observed

requirements.reason: E0561定义表与E0517的168.9billionUSD、E0515年度比较标签共同支撑，等价于预列E1227语义。

citations.quote: Highlights from fiscal year 2025 compared with fiscal year 2024 included:
Microsoft Cloud revenue increased 23% to $168.9 billion.
Microsoft Cloud revenue and revenue growth Revenue from Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud, Azure and other cloud services, the commercial portion of LinkedIn, and Dynamics 365

requirements.reason: E0117/118/120/122给出报告分部及服务器/云服务和企业伙伴服务两类。

citations.quote: Our Intelligent Cloud segment consists of our public, private, and hybrid server products and cloud services that power modern business and developers. This segment primarily comprises:

Server products and cloud services, including Azure and other cloud services, comprising cloud and AI consumption-based services, GitHub cloud services, Nuance Healthcare cloud services, virtual desktop offerings, and other cloud services; and Server products, comprising SQL Server, Windows Server, Visual Studio, System Center, related Client Access Licenses (“CALs”), and other on-premises offerings.
Enterprise and partner services, including Enterprise Support Services, Industry Solutions, Nuance professional services, Microsoft Partner Network, and Learning Experience.

requirements.reason: E0587明确In millions及2025栏，IC Revenue106265；来源元数据June30 2025与原件同数值XBRL FY2025上下文核对，附带2024列不替代本题FY2025金额。
E0120完整列Azure and other cloud services含cloud/AI consumption、GitHubcloud、NuanceHealthcarecloud、virtualdesktop及other，且与Serverproducts分开。

citations.quote: Server products and cloud services, including Azure and other cloud services, comprising cloud and AI consumption-based services, GitHub cloud services, Nuance Healthcare cloud services, virtual desktop offerings, and other cloud services; and Server products, comprising SQL Server, Windows Server, Visual Studio, System Center, related Client Access Licenses (“CALs”), and other on-premises offerings.

requirements.reason: E0527明确该组合收入增长34%，E0515对应FY2025与FY2024比较；不是美元金额，也非固定汇率标签。原件复核允许等价出处，不锁死E0613。

citations.quote: Highlights from fiscal year 2025 compared with fiscal year 2024 included:
Azure and other cloud services revenue growth of 34%.

requirements.reason: 缺失：最终13块只描述Azure and other cloud services组合，没有Azure自身面向开发者/IT/企业构建、部署、管理应用的平台定义，也无IaaS/PaaS消费驱动。原件E0127有该定义，最终未交付任何等价材料。
E0561组成含Azureandother，E0120显示它在IC服务器/云组合之内，IC另含企业伙伴服务；组成足以支持重叠判别，无需原件出现不可相加四字。未交付任何相加或推算Azure金额。

Enterprise and partner services, including Enterprise Support Services, Industry Solutions, Nuance professional services, Microsoft Partner Network, and Learning Experience.

scope.reason: 仅指定Microsoft FY2025原件，无跨公司/报告替换。

truth.reason: 最终交付金额、增长率、组成与原文一致；未推算Azure金额。缺少平台定义单独计C7missing，不把组合定义冒充完整覆盖。

provenance.reason: 13个DOM原块、原件hash、dataset/query/run和冻结标准均核验；IC金额原件XBRL期间/单位也核对。

focus.reason: 最终同时交付E0527与E0613中相同34%增长，且E0615企业伙伴服务增长整块对问题无必要，可删除而不损覆盖。额外产品收入表用于有限披露核查，不能替代C7平台定义；即使保留该表也应控制冗余。

deliveries.quote: Our Intelligent Cloud segment consists of our public, private, and hybrid server products and cloud services that power modern business and developers. This segment primarily comprises:

Server products and cloud services, including Azure and other cloud services, comprising cloud and AI consumption-based services, GitHub cloud services, Nuance Healthcare cloud services, virtual desktop offerings, and other cloud services; and Server products, comprising SQL Server, Windows Server, Visual Studio, System Center, related Client Access Licenses (“CALs”), and other on-premises offerings.
Enterprise and partner services, including Enterprise Support Services, Industry Solutions, Nuance professional services, Microsoft Partner Network, and Learning Experience.
Highlights from fiscal year 2025 compared with fiscal year 2024 included:
Microsoft Cloud revenue increased 23% to $168.9 billion.
Server products and cloud services revenue increased 23% driven by Azure and other cloud services revenue growth of 34%.

Enterprise and partner services revenue increased $166 million or 2% driven by growth in Enterprise Support Services, offset in part by a decline in Industry Solutions.

conditional_context_assessment.reason: 题目仅FY2025；FY2024比较列及其百分比为保留原表的附带信息，未另作跨版本/FY2024可比性分析。没有事后把它扩大为必须交付历史重组段的任务。若下游实际解释跨期可比性需再取重列说明。
conditional_context_assessment.actual_growth_basis: E0515明示FY2025相较FY2024，为增长期间的等价说明；无固定汇率结论。

category_interpretation.table_structure: 定义表和分部表的非必需附带数据，可进一步裁切，不是全部必要语法。
category_interpretation.necessary_context: 同一短增长句中对服务器产品大类增长的引导，非Azure组合34%的独立必需内容。

minimum_sufficient_delivery.reason: C7缺失；另有重复增长、无关企业伙伴服务增长及大表附带材料。

limitations: 不因系统自审通过而降低冻结七要点。
